From Purple Haze · Price: the virus hits allies and you too.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: break a capsule in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-ft burst}: @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates), including allies and you.
  • 5: Persistent damage equals @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[persistent,poison]].
  • 9: Surge: three capsules at once, each in a different burst.
  • 13: 1 action: kill your virus in one burst, ending its persistent damage on everyone there (the virus also dies in direct sunlight).
  • 17: A critical failure also makes the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 2}.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
